biography.zh: 叶镐恺，宁波东方理工大学力学与机械工程学院2025级本科生，是学校2025年招收的创校首届学生。
biography.en: Haokai Ye is an undergraduate student in the School of Mechanics and Mechanical Engineering at the Eastern Institute of Technology, Ningbo (EIT). Admitted in 2025, he is a member of the university's inaugural undergraduate cohort.

home_intro.zh: 欢迎访问我的主页。我是叶镐恺，宁波东方理工大学力学与机械工程学院2025级本科生，也是学校2025年招收的创校首届学生。
home_intro.en: Welcome to my homepage. I am Haokai Ye, an undergraduate student in the School of Mechanics and Mechanical Engineering at the Eastern Institute of Technology, Ningbo (EIT), and a member of the university's inaugural undergraduate cohort admitted in 2025.

home_research.zh: 我目前在力学与机械工程学院学习专业基础课程，对力学和机械工程领域抱有浓厚兴趣，希望在本科阶段逐步参与科研训练。
home_research.en: I am currently building a foundation in mechanics and mechanical engineering at EIT, and I hope to get involved in research training as my undergraduate studies progress.
